adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code wraps the axios call with `refreshOAuthTokens()`. When `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is true and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is set, `refreshOAuthTokens` (from `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a Fetch `Response` object directly from the endpoint. However, the existing code at line 217+ accesses `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` and `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.expiryDate`, which is Axios response structure. A Fetch Response doesn't have a `.data` property - it requires `.json()` to be called. This mismatch means when credential sync is enabled, the code will fail because it tries to access `.data` on a Fetch Response object.
